product.title: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St Peter’s Basilica Guided Tour

description.text: In Rome, discover the Vatican on a group tour of the Sistine Chapel and the Vatican Museums with an expert guide. Navigate the vast complex of rooms, artwork, and history with a guide, who brings the ancient collection to life. Stops include Vatican Museums, Cortile della Pigna, Sphere within a Sphere, Galleria Delle Carte Geografiche, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica. Skip all the entrance lines to explore halls such as the Gallery of the Maps; step inside the Sistine Chapel to admire ‘The Creation of Adam’ by Michelangelo and finish your tour visiting St. Peter's Basilica. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
